name: Montage Palmetto Bluff
insider_take: A quintessential Lowcountry escape where Southern charm meets luxury on 20,000 pristine acres along the May River.
whats_special: This stunning resort sits on a historic bluff where the May River meets the Intracoastal Waterway. The property features authentic Lowcountry architecture with sprawling porches and Spanish moss-draped oak trees. The resort's May River Golf Club consistently ranks among America's top courses, designed by Jack Nicklaus to preserve the natural wetlands and maritime forest.
pro_tip: Book a sunset river cruise from the resort's marina - the May River is one of the few remaining undeveloped river systems on the East Coast, offering incredible wildlife viewing including dolphins, manatees, and over 200 bird species.
dont_miss: The historic ruins of Palmetto Bluff Tabby (a concrete-like material made from oyster shells) scattered throughout the property, remnants of the original 1800s plantation. Also explore the Village of May River with its charming boutiques and waterfront dining, designed to replicate a traditional Southern river town.
pros: Stunning waterfront location on South Carolina's May River
Jack Nicklaus Signature Golf Course on-site
Exceptional Southern hospitality and personalized service
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Secluded Lowcountry location requires planned transportation
